sn56.33:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave daṇḍo uparivehāsaṃ khitto sakimpi mūlena nipatati sakimpi majjhena nipatati sakimpi aggena nipatati.
sn56.33:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave avijjā nīvaraṇā sattā taṇhāsaññojanā sandhāvantā saṃsarantā sakimpi asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchanti sakimpi parasmā lokā imaṃ lokaṃ āgacchanti.
sn56.33:2.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
